# Trailhead Supply Co.

> Trailhead Supply Co. is an online retailer of outdoor and camping gear: tents, packs, cook systems, footwear and trail apparel.

This is a static fallback. The live, catalog-synced version is served from
GET /llms.txt on the API (see server/src/controllers/seoController.js) --
proxy that route at the site root in production for up-to-date content.
